notes.title: -25% All Hallow's Eve sale and Version 1.2!
Version 1.2
notes.content:
Combat skill changes:

- Death wish, Defence: -2 to -1
- Deceiving ritual, Attack: -2 to -1
- Twin Strike, Defence: 0 to +1
- Animal Instinct, Attack: -1 to 0A
- Destroy the weak, Attack: -1 to 0
- Purifying Waters, Defence: +2 to +3, Attack -2 to -3
- Desperate Times, Defence: +1 to +2
- Man's best friend, Attack: -1 to 0
- Elusive dodge, Defence: -1 to 0

Enemy changes:
[spoiler]- Louhi: Defence bonus: 7 -> 8 [/spoiler]

- Attack and Defence bonus can now be over +9

notes.title: Version 1.1 - The Difficulty Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35183915/e7484cbebc8836eaf7dd3fcfc22686a16d0b75d0.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.1 - The Difficulty Update [/h1]
- 3 difficulty levels: Easy, Normal & Hard
- Added "Restart Quest" button to pause menu
- New enemy: Deadly adder
- New encounter pictures
- New sound effects
- Changes to encounter locations in "Amulet thief" and "Iku-Turso" quests
- New death frames for hiisi & Injured hiisi
- Major text changes

notes.title: Patch notes, 24th of July
notes.content:
- Moved some encounters in Lord of the Forest quest
- Added a new tonttu to the game
- Added new sounds to some encounters
- New map icon for "Will of the wisp" encounter
- Numerous text changes
- Fixed a bug with boldened texts in Crowned Tyrant quest

notes.title: Patch notes, 19th of July
notes.content:
- Improved the tutorial arrow visuals
- Fixed a bug in Lord of the Forest quest
- Deer hunt changes:
- Adult deer: +6 food to +5 food
- Young deer: +5 food to +4 food
- Medium-sized text changes

notes.title: Patch notes, 18th of July
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where enemy's skill modifiers were not shown correctly

- Iku-Turso uses special attacks less often than before

- Elusive dodge: changed -2 defence to -1 defence

- Tiny text changes

notes.title: Hotfix, 17th of July
notes.content:
- Fixed a major bug related to Sacred Spring
- Updating the game is recommended

notes.title: Patch notes, 17th of July
notes.content:
- Added new enemy: Netherfolk Sorcerers

- Updated the encounter title visuals

- Fixed a bug that reset the volume levels when starting a new game

notes.title: Patch notes, 16th of July
notes.content:
- Fixed the combat indicators 

- Several text changes

- Fixed a bug about playing the game in debug mode

notes.title: Patch notes, 15th of July
notes.content:
- Improved the tutorial

- Added more indicators to combat: "poison", "steal" and self damage
